name: Choosing AI Models and Vendors
description: A vendor-neutral method for choosing LLMs: map the market, read benchmarks skeptically, build your own eval set, model real costs including caching, batch, reasoning tokens and self-hosting, check data terms and open-weight licenses, and record the decision in a repeatable scorecard.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Choosing AI Models and Vendors

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 15 lessons in 5 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
